diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

null_resource.wait_for_cluster lists aws_eks_cluster.this in its explicit depends_on, but its local-exec provisioner already sets environment = { ENDPOINT = aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint }, which establishes the same ordering implicitly (aws_eks_cluster.this is present in this node's implicit_deps). The depends_on entry on aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant; only aws_security_group_rule.cluster_private_access needs to remain in depends_on.
